dict.string: Echo uses your microphone only when you hold the voice button to ask a question or give a command.
Echo converts your spoken question or command into text so it can create your guide or run your task.

Echo reads and manages your contacts only when you explicitly ask it to — for example, to delete duplicates or find someone. Echo always shows you a full plan and asks for confirmation before making any changes.
Echo accesses your photo library only when you ask it to — for example, to find large videos or clear old screenshots. Echo shows you exactly what it will remove before doing anything.
Echo can save annotated guide images to your photo library when you request it.
Echo creates or manages reminders only when you ask it to. You review every action before it runs.
Echo creates or reads calendar events only when you ask it to. You review every action before it runs.
